newsitem.title: USA: AMBAC qualifies four muni issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: AMBAC qualifies four muni issues for insurance.

text.p: AMBAC Indeminity Corp. on Monday said that it qualified four municipal bond issues, which will be sold competitively today.
--Traverse Area Pub, Mich., $15 million school building bonds.
--North Richland Hills, Texas, $4.1 million limited tax bonds.
--North Richland Hills, Texas, $2.755 million certificate of participation bonds.
--Oostburg School District, Wis., $4.25 million school building general obligations bonds. --U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
